field.name: Name
field.poolHint: Which poller pool polls this node. Leave blank to inherit from its group, or fall back to the default pool. Takes effect on the next poll round.
field.poolInvalid: Use only letters, digits, '_' or '-' (max 63 characters).

inventory.filterTruncated: Showing the first {{count}} matches — narrow the search to see the rest.
inventory.groupTruncated: Some large groups are showing a partial member list. Use search to find a specific node.
inventory.revealTruncated: Too many groups matched to open them all — narrow the search to see their members.
inventory.selectPrompt: Select a node or group to see its detail.
inventory.filterScanTruncated: Some matches are not shown: the filter examined as many nodes as it is allowed to. Add a search term to narrow it.

add.poolHint: Which poller pool polls this node. Leave blank to inherit from the group it lands in.

group.poolHint: Nodes in this group (and its subgroups) are polled by this pool unless they set their own. Leave blank to inherit.
group.geoHint: Where this group sits on the Geo map. Set both or leave both blank to remove the pin.
group.geoInherited: Already on the map at {{name}}, inherited from the folder above — nodes in this group are counted at that pin. Set coordinates here only to give this group a pin of its own.

deleteGroup.impact: {{subgroups}} and {{members}} move up to the parent

err.geoPair: enter both latitude and longitude, or leave both blank
err.geoNumber: latitude and longitude must be numbers
err.geoRange: latitude must be between -90 and 90, longitude between -180 and 180

filter.chartHint: Port, peer and AS filters narrow the tables and diagram; the trend shows all traffic for the selected protocols.

flow.none: No flow data in this window.
flow.noTrend: No traffic trend in this window.
flow.empty: No flow data yet. Configure this device to export NetFlow v9 / IPFIX to the poller (default UDP :2055).
flow.disabled: Flow monitoring is not enabled. Configure a ClickHouse flow store (YAGRA_CLICKHOUSE_URL on core) and a flow listener (YAGRA_FLOW_BIND on the poller) to collect traffic flows.

editNode.profileOffKind: This profile belongs to another kind of node. It is listed only because it is the one currently bound.

err.bindingsAfterCheck: The monitor settings were saved, but the node settings were not: {{reason}}. Saving again is safe.

deleteNode.title: Delete node
deleteNode.body: Delete node {{name}}? This removes its inventory entry and its discovered interfaces. Collected metrics age out of the TSDB. If this node is a parent in a dependency chain, its dependents will no longer be suppressed by it. This cannot be undone.

overview.bodyTruncated: The body was larger than the read budget, so the rule could not be decided.
overview.historyEmpty: No changes recorded — the resolution has been stable.

interfaces.emptyDiscovered: No interfaces discovered yet. They appear after an SNMP table walk runs — the node needs a bound SNMP credential and a table metric in its collection set.
interfaces.colOperTitle: Operational status — whether the interface is up or down
interfaces.dockHint: Select an interface to dock its charts.
interfaces.closeDetailTitle: Close detail (or click the row again)
interfaces.resizeDock: Drag to resize the charts (double-click to reset)
interfaces.rateUnitToggleTitleBps: Plotting bits per second — click for packets per second
interfaces.rateUnitToggleTitlePps: Plotting unicast packets per second (multicast and broadcast are not counted, and the bandwidth line does not apply) — click for bits per second
interfaces.scaleToggleTitleCapacity: Y-axis scaled to bandwidth — click for auto-fit
interfaces.scaleToggleTitleAuto: Y-axis auto-fits traffic — click to scale to bandwidth
interfaces.noData: No data for this window yet…

collection.subFailing: No recent SNMP values — the device may be unreachable or denying SNMP
collection.subNone: No SNMP credential bound; only ICMP availability is collected
collection.editNote: SNMP metrics polled from this node. Node-level entries override the device profile; with none set, the profile / built-in defaults apply.
collection.allMetricsNote: Everything this node collects or has data for. Open a row to chart it.

groupDetail.noDirectMembers: No direct member nodes — see subgroups.

suppression.markReleasedMaint: Released from maintenance — click to put it back
suppression.markReleasedMute: Released from the mute — click to put it back

from.elsewhere: From a profile, tag or fleet-wide window

act.excludeNode: Take this node out of maintenance

suppression.none: Nothing is suppressing this any more.

tree.dragHint: Drag onto a group to nest/assign; drag between rows to reorder.
tree.emptyInventory: No nodes in inventory. Add one to start monitoring.
tree.poolNoLivePoller: No live poller serves this pool — nodes assigned to it are not polled.

setPool.title: Poller pool for {{name}}
setPool.groupHint: Nodes in this group (and its subgroups) are polled by this pool unless they set their own. Leave blank to inherit. Takes effect on the next poll round.

setParent.title: Dependency for {{name}}
setParent.hint: When this upstream is down, {{name}}'s alert is suppressed and rolled up under it.

checkEdit.removeConfirm: Stop probing this target? The node stays in the inventory but is no longer checked, and its recorded history is kept.
checkEdit.verifyTlsWarning: With verification off, an intercepted or expired certificate is reported as healthy.
checkEdit.credentialNeedsTls: A monitor that presents credentials must verify TLS.
checkEdit.bodyMatch: Check the response body for a keyword
checkEdit.bodyMatchHint: Catches an endpoint that answers 200 while its body says the service is broken.
checkEdit.bodyPatternHint: Matched as plain text, case-sensitively — not a regular expression.
checkEdit.jsonExtract: Record values from a JSON body
checkEdit.jsonExtractHint: Lift numbers out of the response and record them under names you choose. A rule that finds no number records nothing for that poll, rather than a zero.
checkEdit.bodyMaxBytesHint: How much of the body to read, for both the keyword check and any extracted values. If a keyword is not found within it, the check reports a failure rather than a pass.
checkEdit.bodyMatchNeedsBody: A HEAD request returns no body — use GET or POST to check content.
checkEdit.resolverHint: Leave empty to use the poller's own resolver.
checkEdit.maxDepthHint: How far a CNAME chain may be followed.

err.urlScheme: The URL must start with http:// or https://.
err.timeout: The timeout must be a whole number of milliseconds, at least 1.
err.statusCodes: Give one or more status codes between 100 and 599.
err.statusRange: Give a range between 100 and 599, with the first value no higher than the second.
err.bodyPatternRequired: A keyword is required for the content check.
err.bodyPatternTooLong: The keyword may be at most 512 characters.
err.bodyMaxBytes: The read budget must be between 1024 and 1048576 bytes.
err.bodyMatchNeedsBody: A HEAD request returns no body — use GET or POST to check content.
err.extractMetricRequired: Each extracted value needs a metric name.
err.extractPathRequired: Each extracted value needs a path.
err.extractMetricName: A metric name may use letters, digits, underscores and colons, and may not start with a digit.
err.extractMetricReserved: That name is already used by one of this monitor's own metrics — choose another.
err.extractMetricDuplicate: Two rules cannot record to the same metric name.
err.extractPathTooLong: A path may be at most 256 characters.
err.tooManyExtracts: A monitor may record at most 8 extracted values.
err.dnsNameRequired: A name to resolve is required.
err.resolverPort: The port must be between 1 and 65535.
err.maxDepth: The hop limit must be a whole number, at least 1.
err.save: Could not save the monitor configuration.
err.remove: Could not remove the monitor configuration.

neighbors.truncated: Too many neighbors to record them all — some were dropped.
neighbors.historyEmpty: No changes recorded. Neighbors are only written down when they actually change, so a rack nobody is repatching stays empty here.

empty.disabled: Neighbor discovery is switched off for this deployment. Turn it on in Settings ▸ System settings.
empty.unrecorded: Nothing recorded yet. Only SNMP devices are walked, and a device that speaks neither LLDP nor CDP never reports any.
empty.none: This device was walked and reports no neighbors.

diff.unchangedDetail: First observation recorded for this node.
